description: Gate a candidate diff behind an independent, multi-reviewer consensus before integrating it. Spawn several biased reviewers (architect, quality, tests) that each judge the SAME diff in isolation, then apply a fixed truth table - integrate only when no reviewer rejects and at least one approves. Use when a single-pass review (marshal-orchestrate step 4) is not enough: a high-stakes merge, or when you want a quorum instead of one opinion. The engine runs the agents; this playbook is the judgment.
